title: The "Disclosure President"?
excerpt: A several figures in the UFO world have referred to Trump at "The Disclosure President".
content:
• #1

A several figures in the UFO world have referred to Trump at "The Disclosure President".

For example, David Grusch on his recent Joe Rogan appearance (ep.#2560) made several mentions of Trump's "courage" on the topic and his unique ability to make disclosure happen.

I believe before Trump's term ends that it's all going to come out.

[24:16]

before Trump leaves office, we're going to be in a new paradigm.

[29:04]

if Trump doesn't enforce his order and see this through, I don't think any other president is going to be able to.

[32:39]

Elsewhere, Michael Salla, is positively effusive about both Trump's personal knowledge and commitment to disclosure.
Source: https://youtu.be/rdXmz0VPd7Q?si=VquWqrz0-pD91s5U
[I didn't time stamp these remarks but they're just over half way in].

Other figures have explicitly called Trump the "Disclosure President" ; partisan cheerleaders Tim Burchett and Eric Burlison.
Source: https://x.com/timburchett/status/2079630453389299734?s=20

https://podscan.fm/podcasts/that-uf...n-exclusive-trump-is-the-disclosure-president
This just seems like obvious politicking for the low information voter.

It's also been noted in other threads https://www.metabunk.org/threads/wa...be-the-disclosure-president.14593/post-357936

So, what is it about Trump that makes people believe 1) that he has a better personal understanding of the topic than past presidents, and 2) that his administration is going to be the one that leads to a "new paradigm"? It seems completely at odds with any public statement I've heard Trump make about UFOs — speaking in his typical vague-bluster. His actions, such as the DOD releases, heavily redacted evidence of birds and balloons troubling US operators, are not evidence of alien visitation. He also started one and failed to end another war over a presumably obsolete fossil fuel (I'm assuming UFOs are not powered by petroleum).

There's also the unlikely idea that Trump would exercise his power to do something for the benefit of humanity as a whole, instead he seems only interested in alienating people by transactional politics. Perhaps, since we're only two short years from disclosure, to get the inside-line, we should have a whip round to raise the ($100k!) funds for early access to his Truth Social posts.
